# Divyataa International School

> A pure Montessori school in Tirupur, Tamil Nadu, India, for children from KG (age 3) to Grade 6. Run by the SMR Pavalammal Educational Trust.

- Programmes: Casa / KG (ages 3 to 5), Lower Elementary (Grades 1 to 3), Upper Elementary (Grades 4 to 6)
- Approach: child-led learning, mixed-age classrooms, trained Montessori guides, three uninterrupted hours of work every morning, no rote learning or rank-based assessment
- Founders: Gi. Sudakar (Chairman and Founder), Kavitha Sudakar (Principal and Co-Founder)
- Address: #76/6, Angeripalayam Main Road, Tirupur 641 603, Tamil Nadu, India
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 97511 12300, +91 84284 12300
- Email: divyataa.info@gmail.com
